name: breaker
description: A circuit breaker for credits. It counts a session together with the subagents it started, trips at your limit, lets the running turn finish, and resets when you say.
author: Matt Avila
highlights: A session's true total: its own turns plus every subagent it started
A shadow cap that reports when a limit would have tripped, and stops nothing
A real cap on work started from Breaker, held with no page open
A real cap on your own goal loops, held while a Breaker page is open
A replay of a reported overspend, with and without subagents counted
useCases: When you leave a goal loop running overnight, start it from Breaker with a credit limit, so it stops before its next cycle once the limit is reached
When you want to know what a cap would have done, set a shadow cap on a session and read when it would have tripped and how far spend ran past it
When a session's spend looks too low, open Breaker to see what its subagents added
